overview: In FRM-like/1, newtonCos initializes z from pixel. The loop computes denom = sin(z)+(1,0), keeps z when its squared size is below 1e-10, and otherwise assigns z + (cos(z)-z)/denom. The pinned julia profile uses 96 iterations.
mathSummary: starts z from pixel; in each iteration defines denom = sin(z)+(1,0), keeps z unchanged when the squared real-and-imaginary size of denom is below 1e-10, otherwise assigns z + (cos(z)-z)/denom; bailout is |z - zPrev| >= 0.000001.

sourceWalkthrough.explanation: Initialization: init/0 sets z from pixel.
Branch: loop/1 keeps z when denom has squared size below 1e-10; otherwise it assigns z + (cos(z)-z)/denom.

syntaxFeatures.explanation: The cited annotations connect z = pixel, denom = sin(z)+(1,0), and the change-based bailout.
The cited branch keeps z for a squared denom size below 1e-10; otherwise it applies z + (cos(z)-z)/denom.

steps: Use the pinned julia profile with all controls fixed. Run 48 iterations and then 96 iterations, and record whether the sin(z)+(1,0) denominator guard or the cosine update changes the observed iteration counts.
parameterExperiment.expectedObservation: The larger cap may expose additional guarded or unguarded cosine updates; record whether the iteration counts differ.
